title: LLM-based Agentic Reasoning Frameworks: A Survey from Methods to Scenarios
abstract: arXiv:2508.17692v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Recent advances in LLM-based agents highlight the importance of their reasoning frameworks, which guide the problem-solving process in diverse ways. This survey introduces a unified formal language to systematically categorize these frameworks at three compositional levels: single-agent, tool-based, and multi-agent methods. Following our taxonomy, we review key application scenarios across scientific discovery, healthcare, software engineering, society, economics, and general-purpose tasks. It also compares the distinct features and evaluation strategies of each category. Through our taxonomy and comparisons, our survey explores the designs and strengths of LLM-based agentic frameworks in different scenarios, reviewing the fast-paced development of complex agentic systems in the real world.

translated_title: 基于大语言模型的智能体推理框架：从方法到场景的综述
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体的最新进展凸显了其推理框架的重要性，这些框架以多种方式引导问题求解过程。本综述引入了一种统一的形式化语言，在三个组成层级上对这些框架进行系统分类：单智能体方法、基于工具的方法和多智能体方法。依照我们的分类体系，我们回顾了涵盖科学发现、医疗健康、软件工程、社会、经济以及通用任务等关键应用场景。本综述还比较了每个类别的独特特征和评估策略。通过我们的分类与比较，本综述探讨了基于大语言模型的智能体框架在不同场景下的设计与优势，回顾了复杂智能体系统在现实世界中的快速发展历程。
tldr: 本综述提出一种统一的形式化语言，将基于大语言模型的智能体推理框架在单智能体、基于工具和多智能体三个层级上进行系统分类，并综述了其在科学发现、医疗健康、软件工程等场景中的应用特征与评估策略。
en_tdlr: This survey introduces a unified formal language to systematically categorize LLM-based agentic reasoning frameworks at three levels—single-agent, tool-based, and multi-agent—and reviews their distinct features and evaluation strategies across scenarios including scientific discovery, healthcare, and software engineering.
